title: Deductible Part and Time-of-Service Cap in Site-Change Estimates — Referrals & Prior Authorizations
content:
In the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), the deductible part of the estimate rests on one figure: the remaining deductible on the patient's Patient Financial Account multiplied by the deductible rate and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent. Then:

- where the rate is above zero and that figure reaches the financial class's time-of-service collection cap, the deductible part is the cap;
- where the rate is above zero and some deductible remains, the deductible part is that figure;
- otherwise the deductible part is zero.

"Reaches" means the rounded figure is equal to or greater than the cap. The cap is a setting of the financial class; the remaining deductible is the amount recorded on the patient's own account.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts and class cap of 150.00)

| Remaining deductible | Rate | Figure (rounded half up to the cent) | Deductible part |
|---|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 25 percent | 200.00 — reaches the cap | 150.00 |
| 400.00 | 25 percent | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| 123.45 | 30 percent | 37.035, rounded to 37.04 | 37.04 |
| 600.00 | 25 percent | 150.00 — equal to the cap, so it reaches it | 150.00 |
| 0.00 | 25 percent | 0.00 — no deductible remains | 0.00 |
| 800.00 | zero | — | 0.00 |

The figure is rounded to the cent first; the rounded figure is what is compared with the cap.
